banked_reason: The required matching unknown converse is not proved. The full-class sharp exponent, essential logarithms, and supplied-allocation ratio remain unresolved. proof_attempt_summary: Derived an attained full-class unknown-allocation upper of order n^(-2/9), a lower of order n^(-1/4), and matched supplied-e and fixed-alphabet benchmarks. One scoped attempt at a matching full-product-mixture converse failed through a third-record moment mismatch and quarter-Holder membership violation, producing honest obstruction lemmas. The sharp unknown rate and allocation price remain open; mathematical review passes, but the result is incremental below the field floor. No Lean formalization was launched or certified.
tldr: On the unchanged quarter-H\"older causal law class, supplied allocation has testing radius of order \(n^{-1/4}\). The proved unknown-allocation bracket is \(n^{-1/4}/16\le\rho_n<2^{20}n^{-2/9}\). The proved node \(\text{thm:band-upper}\) supplies an original-record test at separation \(1701\eta_n\) with exact finite size and power guarantees. The required matching unknown converse is not proved. New normalized-prior checks expose a higher-order moment term and a spatial membership failure in one growing-block candidate. The sharp unknown rate, essential logarithms, and allocation price remain open.
gap: Jain--Luedtke provide asymptotic conditional-law testing under nuisance-rate conditions. Neykov et al. provide transport conditional-independence testing with joint conditional-law smoothness. Neither evaluates the quarter-Hölder arm-only integrated-\(W_1\) frontier when allocation is arbitrary.
fill: The completion obligation is an explicit matched original-record radius, a total finite-size attaining test, and the exact same-full-class supplied-function comparison. Covariance-sensitive outcome-band control and normalized localized fuzzy hypotheses are competing handles for that obligation.
